name: MeasurementSystemInput
description: an input for selecting a measurement system
status: beta — implemented and unit-tested in all seven frameworks with an axe-clean demo page; not yet exercised in composed flows
aria: `aria-label` -- set from the `label` prop to provide an accessible name
keyboard: Native `<input type="text">` keyboard behavior (typing, selection, clipboard)
props: `value`: string (default: "", bindable) -- bindable measurement system name
`required`: boolean (default: false) -- whether the field is required
`disabled`: boolean (default: false) -- whether the field is disabled
`...restProps`: Any additional HTML attributes passed to the `<input>` element
